title: Index Unicode names with canonical collision protection
instruction: Harden UnicodeNamespace without changing register, lookup, or display_name. Names must be exact strings, non-empty, already free of leading/trailing whitespace, and contain only Unicode letters/numbers plus ASCII underscore, hyphen, or dot. Reject control, format, surrogate, private-use, unassigned, combining-mark-only, separator, and NUL characters. Canonical keys use Unicode NFKC followed by casefold; validate the normalized result again and reject names whose normalized key is empty. register rejects every canonical collision atomically, stores the first original spelling for display_name, and may store any value without copying it. lookup and display_name apply identical validation and normalization and raise KeyError only for a valid unknown name. Failed operations never mutate existing entries. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-3 Unicode lineage with NFKC/casefold collision semantics and strict identifier-category validation.
